description: This file defines the DynamicShadowSettings class which adjusts shadow parameters dynamically based on the camera's height and environment interactions in a Unity scene.

classes.name: DynamicShadowSettings
classes.description: A Unity MonoBehaviour that adjusts the shadow settings based on the camera's height and environment interactions.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes the original shadow strength of the sun light.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Per frame, adjusts shadow distance, bias, and strength based on camera height and raycast hit information.
